findings.title: specs/002-builder-modelli/data-model.md not updated after PortaDiscovery redesign
findings.evidence: Lines 36-39 still describe PortaDiscovery.tipologie_disponibili / profili_disponibili / attributi_profilo / campi_disponibili as the port's four methods. This diff's specs/010-configurazione-cataloghi-integrazioni/data-model.md:24 redefines the canonical port as a single catalogo_discovery(codice_tipo_documento, forza_aggiornamento=False) -> CatalogoDiscovery method (matching backend/app/discovery/port.py), and 010's doc explicitly tells readers to consult the 002 note for the port shape ('la 002 la consuma senza ridefinirla, vedi nota in specs/002-builder-modelli/data-model.md'). Two of the four methods listed in 002 (profili_disponibili, attributi_profilo) were never implemented in backend/app/discovery/adapter_locale.py even before this diff, so the cross-referenced doc was already partly aspirational and is now fully out of sync with the real interface.
findings.recommendation: Update the PortaDiscovery section of specs/002-builder-modelli/data-model.md to reference catalogo_discovery (or replace it with a pointer to 010's data-model.md) so the two mutually cross-referencing specs stay consistent.

findings.title: Discovery error codes bypass the shared ErrorCode registry
findings.evidence: DiscoveryError is raised with raw string codes 'DISCOVERY_NON_CONFORME' (errors.py:12) and 'DISCOVERY_NON_DISPONIBILE' (adapter_http.py:80-82, 114-116) instead of app.common.errors.ErrorCode members. Every other DomainError subclass in the codebase (CatalogError in app/catalog/service.py, BuilderDomainError in app/builder/service.py, PayloadValidationDomainError in app/validation/service.py) is always constructed with an ErrorCode enum value, and backend tests (e.g. tests/catalog/test_catalogo_categorie_api.py) assert against that enum. ErrorCode is a closed StrEnum that does not list these two new codes, so it silently stops being the single source of truth for valid API error codes.
findings.recommendation: Add DISCOVERY_NON_CONFORME and DISCOVERY_NON_DISPONIBILE as members of app.common.errors.ErrorCode and raise DiscoveryError with those enum members, matching the pattern used by every other domain error in the codebase.

findings.title: Active feature 010 has no requirements checklist
findings.evidence: Every other feature directory in feature_inventory (specs/001 through specs/009) contains checklists/requirements.md; specs/010-configurazione-cataloghi-integrazioni does not, and review_scope.included_documents for 010 correspondingly omits it. FR-001..FR-015, including the two requirements added in this diff (FR-014, FR-015), have no checklist-based traceability for this active/READY feature.
findings.recommendation: Run the Spec Kit checklist step for feature 010 to produce checklists/requirements.md, covering at minimum FR-012 (GEMODO_ADMIN), FR-014 and FR-015, before closing out the increment.

findings.title: 9 of 10 Spec Kit features remain unreviewed since 2026-09-01
findings.evidence: feature_inventory.features in the review request lists specs/001-catalogo-contratto-geban through specs/009-fondamenta-mock-test-qualita all with review_status CHANGED or FAILED, last_verdict FAIL, last_reviewed_at 2026-09-01T14:17:13Z, and needs_review true; feature_inventory.reviewed_features is empty and none have been re-reviewed since that date.
findings.recommendation: Schedule re-review passes for specs/001 through specs/009 against their current documents (not only the active feature 010) to clear the standing FAIL verdicts in the ledger, as the review instructions require checking features_needing_review even when they are not the active feature.
